recentItems.title: The Heat: Middle East Crisis | Conflict spreads
recentItems.description:
Iran and the US have not held any substantive talks since the Memorandum of Understanding collapsed in July. 

On Tuesday, Tehran said there will be no talks until its conditions are met. Those conditions include the US lifting its naval blockade and economic sanctions, releasing Iranian frozen assets and ending Israel’s attacks on Lebanon and Gaza.

Meanwhile, the Houthis in Yemen have made significant advances in recent weeks by seizing the port city of Mokha and several islands along the Red Sea. #Iran #SaudiArabia #Yemen #Houthis #RedSea #MiddleEast 

The Heat host: Anand Naidoo 

Guests:
Setareh Sadeqi is an Assistant Professor with the Faculty of World Studies at the University of Tehran. Salman Al-Ansari is a Saudi Geopolitical Analyst.
Hussein Banai is an Associate Professor of International Studies at the Hamilton Lugar School of Global and International Studies at Indiana University – Bloomington.

recentItems.title: 100-second aerial look at Pinglu Canal #coolchina
recentItems.description:
Pinglu Canal, a backbone project of the New International Land-Sea Trade Corridor, officially opened to navigation on September 16, 2026, marking a historic milestone.  

Aerial footage captures the canal as it carves through mountains and valleys, linking rivers to the sea. Witness the magnificent power of this century-defining project, a waterway that connects China's interior to the ocean and carries a region's dreams seaward.

recentItems.title: Mid-Autumn Vibes | The power of flower buns
recentItems.description:
As the Mid-Autumn Festival approaches, steamed flower buns and giant mooncakes begin filling dining tables in Shichuan Town, northwest China's Gansu Province. For fruit farmer Chen Qingjun and his family, these sweet treats represent reunion and a fruitful harvest.
